request.question: Should you and your partner share one single to-do list, or keep separate lists that you can share with each other?

options.does: One shared list for both of us.
options.cost: The default; one list, no per-user data.

consequence.answer: One shared list for both of us

options.does: Separate lists, each shareable with the other.

consequence.answer: Separate lists, each shareable with the other

proposal.recommended_answer: Neither option as asked: the app is multi-user. Each user signs in and has several lists of their own; a list has several items; an item has a state.

grounds.how: product/p07 states that a to-do app is multi-user and each user has several lists of their own, which neither option gives.
company/c28 builds nothing for a need nobody named: sharing lists between users was not named.
